<subject>coordination with [LOC_1]</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: Tasman Ridge's iron ore export protocol and the [LOC_1] logistics alignment.

Bryan has generated both high-risk and low-priority counterparty lists which he will forward so that [LOC_3] can verify termination compliance. I believe [LOC_1] can adopt our updated Rail & Port handover framework as a model. Bryan and team members will join the 9:30 a.m. call on 5 Feb.

John and Randy: Can you provide Bryan with the "Kalgoorlie Bulk Terminal LP" operations template, or if superseded, the latest version? Also, could you share the current [ORG_1] framework?

Kyle: Please send Bryan and Meredith Green the approved decision tree and settlement workflow diagram from the Q1 2025 process audit.

If the briefing packs for tomorrow are finalised and include the above materials, they will be sufficient for [LOC_1]'s requirements.

Thanks. SS
